battle_transition.doc: M2-BPR-05 encounter stinger: BattleStinger (game/flow/battle_stinger.gd) plays it in the field before SceneRouter's opaque fade, when BattleRequest.submit opens a battle. A tide line of dark water rises from the bottom edge with a thin foam crest while the field above it dims and greys, holds, then the router fades to black as before (its hidden build and ADR 0029 budgets are unchanged). docs/kb/tech/battle_presentation.md 'Encounter transition'. Times in seconds; crest, wave_amplitude, foam_width and refract are fractions of the screen; wave_frequency is waves across the screen, wave_speed cycles a second; rise_ease is Godot's ease() curve (under 1 = ease out). Colours are palette.json swatches (named in `swatches`, tested). foam_alpha stays at or under battle_vfx's flash cap (effects.json safety.flash_max_alpha). layer sits under SceneRouter.FADE_LAYER. reduced_motion: no rise, no ripple: a plain cross-fade to the deep colour, then the same hold.

barks.doc: Lead-in barks (Lead's intro audit 2026-10-24): rows by encounter id, {line_key, speaker_key, hold_extra_sec}. The line shows over the rising water (BARK_LINE_FMT, the UI theme, bottom_px above the bottom edge, height_px tall), the stinger holds hold_extra_sec longer, and EventBus.dialogue_event('battle_bark', [encounter, line_key, speaker_key]) tells audio. The lines are Narrative's (request M2-NAR-01); an encounter with no row has no bark.
